title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：parking　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 parking 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the driver ① found the parking that no passenger in the station would have recorded, and he said the finding was the whole of the day. The ② parking, meaning the space itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed unrecorded in the book; parking, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ sort of parking in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ parking at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Parking, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the driver said the recording is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the parking was the whole of the matter, meaning the patience and not the space. The ⑥ parking, meaning the patience and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; parking, he said, is either something you find or the only word that means both space and a patience. He said the patience is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ parking had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ parking of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of recording; parking, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ parking I remember is the parking recorded in the timetable, which closed in 1999 and is still recorded as the quietest in the station. ⑩ Parking, my mother said in 2001, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all parking, she said, is a patience that has agreed to look like space. She said the patience was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 停车；停车位（指车站里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 停车；停车位（指那处停车本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：find the parking 找这一处停车
D. n. 停车；停车位（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 停车之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的停车之事）
F. n. 停车；停车位（指时刻表里写到、被记载的那一处）
G. n. 停车、耐性（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 耐性（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: found the parking that no passenger in the station would have recorded
The parking, meaning the space itself and not the ticket
Every sort of parking in that station
the parking at the far platform
the parking was the whole of the matter
the parking had become a line in a timetable
The parking of the whole thing

answers.why: find the parking 意为“找这一处停车”，1992 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯记载的一处停车做了一遍。
parking 意为“停车；停车位”，指那处停车本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记载。
parking 意为“停车；停车位”，指车站里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
parking 意为“停车；停车位”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
parking 意为“停车、耐性”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这处耐性就是那件事的全部。
parking 意为“耐性”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那处停车，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
parking 意为“停车；停车位”，指时刻表里写到、被记载的那一处，到 1997 年这一处成了时刻表里的一行。
parking 意为“停车之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的停车之事是一处车站和三个日子的记载。
parking 意为“停车；停车位”，我记得的是时刻表里记载过的那一处，1999 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一处。
parking 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，停车是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的停车。
